name: Kopi
source:
A spicy personality with a silky exterior to boot, Kopi is that one companion who's ready to hype you up in the morning for the rest of your day.
Energetic and suave, she's the one you can turn to for warming your heart; she is dependable and resourceful.
The one thing Kopi is really good at is keeping from spilling the beans, but with her excellent secret keeping comes the tendency to jump to conclusions, so she can be a little volatile.
Likes: Waking up Early, Nice-Smelling Conditioner, Beans 
Dislikes: Bureaucracy, Management, Unpaid Overtime

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
